description: This file defines the OsHelper class, which provides a static method to determine the operating system (Windows, Linux, or OSX) on which the PHP code is running. It includes constants for OS identifiers and throws an exception if the OS cannot be determined.
published: amespace Api	extbackslash V8	extbackslash Helper	extbackslash OsHelper

classes.name: OsHelper
classes.description: A helper class for detecting the operating system environment in which the PHP code is executing.

methods.name: getOS
methods.description: Returns the current operating system as one of the predefined constants; throws an exception if the OS cannot be determined.
